scenes.title: Tally × Mera
scenes.sub: Mera-powered UX · One passkey, many keys

scenes.title:
One button.
Face ID.
scenes.sub: createPasskeyWithPrfOutput → PRF → keys. No seed phrase, no extension, no gas.
scenes.vo: Sign-up is one button. Face ID creates a passkey, Mera returns its P R F output, and that becomes the account. No seed phrase, no extension, and the welcome credit means no gas either.

scenes.title:
Same passkey.
Same account.
scenes.sub: getPasskeyPrfOutput re-derives the same keys on any device with the synced passkey.
scenes.vo: Coming back is the same gesture. Mera re-derives exactly the same keys, on any device where the passkey syncs.

scenes.title:
Owner. Agent.
Café.
scenes.vo: One passkey, three keys. The owner key changes the rules. A capped agent key can only spend inside them. And a third key signs a café's menu.

scenes.title:
Pricier pick?
A fresh Face ID.
scenes.sub: The owner key signs the cosign only after a new passkey assertion.
scenes.vo: When the agent picks something pricier than the cheapest match, Tally asks for a fresh Face ID before the owner key signs the approval.

scenes.title:
Your Face ID
signs the menu.
scenes.sub: Merchant mode: key /2 signs the EIP-712 menu every 20 s.
scenes.vo: And the non-wallet use: in merchant mode, the café owner's passkey signs the shop's menu every twenty seconds.

scenes.title: web/lib/mera.ts
scenes.vo: All of it lives in one small file, built on Mera's passkey, signing session and viem account functions.

scenes.title: Tally controls the item.
scenes.vo: Tally. Your Face ID is your wallet.
